# mdzgholi.ge - Driver On Call and Car Services in Georgia
URL: https://mdzgholi.ge
Description: mdzgholi.ge offers professional driving services, including sober driver, personal driver, car wash, tow truck (evacuator), battery and tire emergency services, and airport transfers in Tbilisi, Georgia. Available 24/7.
Phone: +995 568 83 47 07

## Services
- Sober Driver (ფხიზელი მძღოლი)
- Personal Driver (პირადი მძღოლი)
- Tow Truck / Evacuator (ევაკუატორი)
- Car Wash with Pickup (მანქანის რეცხვა გადაყვანით)
- Airport Transfer (აეროპორტის ტრანსფერი)
- Battery Jump & Tire Change (აკუმულატორი და საბურავი)
